title: Revisiting Instruction Fine-tuned Model Evaluation to Guide Industrial Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Task and Format Agnostism (TFA) by comparing the relative performance improvements of zero-shot models versus models fine-tuned on target formats, quantifying how much evaluation metrics are artificially inflated by a model's mastery of output formatting artifacts.

Computing the Spearman correlation between various automatic reference-based metrics (like ROUGE) and human judgments to demonstrate how traditional metrics are inherently biased by high syntactic overlap with reference answers.
